_about: Clinical rules used by the care-gap, priority, risk and chat agents. Every value: value, status (published = from the named guideline; design = a choice of this system) and source. Ages in years unless the name says months.

adult_age.source: UAE age of majority; adults decide their own consent, children through a guardian

well_child_interval_months_under_1.source: AAP Bright Futures schedule: visits at 1, 2, 4, 6, 9 and 12 months

well_child_interval_months_after_1.source: AAP Bright Futures schedule: yearly from age 3 (more often between 1 and 3)

well_child_grace_months.source: A visit is overdue 2 months after it was due

developmental_screen_ages_months.source: AAP: developmental screening at 9, 18 and 30 months

autism_screen_ages_months.source: AAP: autism screening at 18 and 24 months

screen_window_months.source: A missed screen counts as a gap from 2 to 12 months after the age it was due

vaccine_catch_up.source: UAE national immunisation schedule: vaccines at 2, 4, 6, 12 and 18 months, so no vaccine for over 6 months before age 2 means one was missed

mmr_first_dose_window_months.source: UAE national immunisation schedule: first measles (MMR) dose at 12 months

mmr_second_dose_window_months.source: UAE national immunisation schedule: second MMR dose in early school years; checked up to age 12

bp_check_every_months.source: USPSTF: blood pressure screening for adults

bp_check_every_months_with_hypertension.source: Follow-up of known high blood pressure at least twice a year (guidelines: every 3-6 months until controlled)

hba1c_every_months_with_diabetes.source: ADA Standards of Care: HbA1c at least twice a year

diabetes_screen.source: ADA and USPSTF: screen from age 35, or earlier with overweight (BMI 25+); repeat every 3 years if normal

cervical_screen.source: Department of Health Abu Dhabi and USPSTF: cervical screening 25-65, every 3 years (smear)

breast_screen.source: Department of Health Abu Dhabi: mammography 40-69 every 2 years

bowel_screen.source: Department of Health Abu Dhabi and USPSTF: bowel screening 45-75, stool test every year

lipid_test.source: USPSTF: lipid testing from 40, every 5 years

lung_screen_ages_smokers.source: USPSTF 2021: lung screening for smokers aged 50-80

premarital_ages.source: UAE premarital screening programme; offered to unmarried carriers in this age range

genetic_rules.source: Familial hypercholesterolaemia: lipid testing from age 2 (AAP/NLA); BRCA: yearly breast imaging from 25 (NCCN); Lynch: colonoscopy every 1-2 years from 25 (NCCN); carrier counselling before marriage age (design: 16); MODY: yearly glucose testing (design)

actionable_variants.source: ACMG: only pathogenic and likely pathogenic variants are acted on; uncertain variants are not

genetic_marker_genes.source: Genes behind each marker group, so a hospital's genetic result (gene symbol) reaches the right rule: familial hypercholesterolaemia LDLR/APOB/PCSK9; hereditary breast and ovarian cancer BRCA1/BRCA2; Lynch syndrome MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2/EPCAM (ACMG secondary findings list); beta-globin HBB; the common MODY genes GCK/HNF1A/HNF4A/HNF1B. A result for any other gene is stored but changes nothing

family_history_diabetes_codes.source: A relative's condition that counts as a family history of diabetes: SNOMED CT diabetes mellitus (73211009), type 2 (44054006), type 1 (46635009), family history of diabetes mellitus (160303001); ICD-10 E10-E14 and Z83.3

consent_when_not_recorded.source: What holds for a person with no consent record. Contact about preventive care by their own care provider is allowed until they say no (they can stop it at any time: STOP, the My care page, or the clinic). Genetic results are never used without a recorded yes. Set contact to false where the Department of Health requires a recorded yes before any outreach

weight_support_bmi.source: WHO: obesity is BMI 30 or more

child_obesity_bmi_percentile.source: CDC and AAP: obesity in children is BMI at or above the 95th percentile

warning_no_visit_days.source: No clinic visit for over 2 years

warning_missed_check_under_age.source: A missed check-up or vaccine is a warning sign under age 6

warning_chronic_test_months.source: A long-term illness with no test for 12 months

warning_er_visits_same_problem.source: 3 or more emergency visits in 12 months for the same problem

results_review_invite_days.source: An abnormal result is offered a review within 2 days

usual_care_checks.source: Checks usual care invites for (by age and sex only); this system adds the rest

check_groups.source: How checks are grouped in the results

urgent_signs.source: Warning signs that make a person Urgent (contact within the Urgent deadline)

value: Long-term illness with no recent test
Many emergency visits for the same problem
high_signs.source: Warning signs that make a person High urgency

blood_sugar_checks.source: Checks that measure blood sugar, so a visit for one of them can find diabetes

never_held_checks.source: Cards a doctor cannot put on hold from the list: an abnormal result or an emergency is always followed up

record_date_for_check.source: Which record date counts as the last test for each genetic-pathway check

value.reason: Urgent but no contact consent, so no messages are sent; decide how to reach this person (for example at their next visit)

no_consent_task.source: An Urgent person who refused messages still needs a clinician's decision; the task closes when consent returns or the person is no longer Urgent

guideline_aliases.source: Checks that use another check's guideline row

case_finding_checks.source: Checks that can find hidden diabetes or high blood pressure. The system cannot see hidden cases, so the evaluation agent watches who completes these checks by group (adults of screening age) and alerts the team when a group falls behind
